summary: Retained PR 1382's justified dense max_seqlen forwarding fix. Reproduced PR 1469's batched numerical failures and showed they came from omitting softmax_scale from the backend forward call; the actual Gemma call semantics match SDPA on gfx950. Full TP=8 readiness remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Against base source, both candidate contract regressions failed because max_seqlen was absent.
Focused forwarding and max-seqlen contracts after the correction.
Exact review-harness mismatch without a forward scale, and SDPA agreement when using the actual Gemma forward-call semantics.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 direct VisionTritonAttention runs: max abs error 0.00195312 versus PyTorch SDPA for both (3,5) and (4,9) when softmax_scale=1.0 is passed to forward.
remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; TP=8 collectives and the reported eight-GPU topology were not exercised.
Gemma-4-31B-it weights were unavailable, so the full multimodal model, hybrid SWA allocation, and HTTP /health readiness were not exercised.
Removing this host synchronization does not prove that earlier GPU kernels or collectives cannot stall.
